source.author: ov
source.text: Dixit idem Phoebe: celerique per aera lapsu contigerant tecti Calmeida nubibus arcem.
source.text_original: Dixit idem Phoebe: celerique per aera lapsu / contigerant tecti Calmeida nubibus arcem.
source.text_english: Phoebe said the same thing: and with a swift glide through the air they had reached the citadel of Calmeida, hidden by clouds.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Accepere deae celerique per aethera lapsu diversas petiere vias.
reuse.text_original: ' / Accepere deae celerique per aethera lapsu / diversas petiere vias.
reuse.text_english: The goddesses received him and, with swift glide through the ether, sought different paths.
